july 6 Notes:


Today was a slow trading day that I did not trade because of work. I would have faded either way just because of how the high tf has been looking.
,

When 9:30 opened, we got an aggressive move lower sweeping a london swing low and then a fast move up by 10:00. 10:00 did offer a setup, but I would most likely not take it. 10:00 opened and manipulated 30 points lower and then made a bullish 1min rejection block that didn’t tap any pd arrays, but played out for a successful trade. If I were to enter, it would be because of all the previous htf narrative so it would act as a continuation, but it is not quite my model. messages.content_text:
day 4

today was a losing day, but not mad about it. it was a good trade. today we was bullish, we had a 4hr RB in a 4hr gap. so i was bullish. when market open. i saw that we created a 5m rb. it was a good limit, however there was the 4hr RB CE and it was tied to 00:00 ko. so i wasn't trying to trade that and waited for 10am. when it was getting close to 10am. i saw that we created eq highs on nq. so i was bullish, however there was no entries for me to run to those eq high. there was a 1m rb ce into a 1m fvg but it was more probability to get stoped by and the go to tp. so i was waiting for a better entry, i saw that we formed a 15m gap so i wanted it to tap there and then go to eqhs, but it never got there and ran to eqh. so i now wanted shorts to 10am ko. a 5m rb formed, so i limit on the 5m, mostly cause we swept eqh on nq and then later es. it was edging my stop but then it displaced lower. this is where i messed up. i shouldve gone BE because the displacement was just trying to head bulish again. making longer wicks on the bottom. but i was confident we was going to go to 10am ko. my stop got filled. 

this wasn't a losing day. its just a pullback for a better wining day. no need to fomo, or blame yourself for losing. we all have losing days, what matters is what you do after you lose. never give up and always believe in yourself and the process. pray, have good habits and stay focused, Jairo.

Day 38

Dude took a little hiatus ngl. Been having a really rough time mentally and emotionally here at home I have a ton going on, last week more partiuclary difficult than most. I didn't "trade" but I did get on the charts through out the week and blow many evals very stupidly. No journal just again being dumb and emotional. Feeling better, I've got goals for this month to be good so I need to lock in and start performing.

Pre Analysis: On the daily we got an inversion and now were tapping into a bearish gap to reject. 4h I wouldn't consider us bearish yet but close to, rallly end of last week, we've retraced setting a higher low now pushing out of some imbalances higher. I dont see a lot special on the 1h, the rebalance lower into some gaps, followed by the overnight rally then sweeping internal sellside at open. On the LTF, 15m we have a lot of low resistance sellside, we fill a 15m bearish and are rejecting out of it through open. I don't have much of a bias, want to wait for the macro and see where we are at that point. 

Coming into the macro we inversed the 15m bearish, BoS w/ displacement to the upside. Longs look good on NQ but we have a bearish SMT, since my draw is higher, I'm looking for it to be disrespected. We come back down into a 1m FVG where I limit long, stops at the candle low, tp at 75pts to half pass my eval for a 1.75R. 4 minute delivery straight to my TP.

Really easy and textbook day for me and my model, super simple, got good delivery 1 and done for the day. Felt refreshed and excited to trade market open today. (edited)
